in_hebrew.name: יְמֵנָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Jemena is derived from the Hebrew word יְמֵנָה (yemēnāh), which means 'Dew from Yah.' In the Bible, dew is often seen as a symbol of God's grace and provision. This name can be a reminder of God's sustaining power and His provision in one's life.

in_greek.name: Ἰακωμένη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Jemena in Greek is transliterated as Ἰακωμένη (Iakōménē). This name is derived from the Hebrew name, and it is composed of the elements 'IAKO' (Jehovah) and 'MEN' (strength). The Greek name Jacomenē means 'Jehovah is strong.'

in_latin.name: Iacomenna
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name for Jemena is Iacomenna. It is derived from the Greek name Jacomenē, which is a transliteration of the Hebrew name יְמֵנָה (yemēnāh). Iacomenna is a feminine name that is composed of the elements 'IA' (Jah) and 'CO' (strength), making it a strong and powerful name.
